requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-5998--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3490-7075-7763-8296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7763-8296.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1174-2092-3664-3869.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-2092-3664-3869.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least X power.
1174-2092-3664-3869.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2440-8167.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more Dragons.
2440-8167.description:
Activate Kiora by paying {8}, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying
When the Dragon enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Repeat.
2440-8167.notes: You may begin the combo controlling less Dragons, but you'll need additional mana to compensate.

147-1893-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-6797.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-4823-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-4823-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-4823-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1479-2841-4288-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4288-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
3899-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1978-4306-7714.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
1978-4306-7714.description:
Cast Nyx Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Nyx Lotus enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Nyx Lotus that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Nyx Lotus into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
During your next turn, activate the Nyx Lotus token by tapping it, adding an amount of mana equal to your devotion to any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Nyx Lotus token.
Repeat from step 4.

1379-2685-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-3197-4017.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1445-5434-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5434-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4377-4477-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-240-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

851-5702-6202.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5702-6202.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
851-5702-6202.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Noyan Dar
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1651-2638-4426-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-4426-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-2638-4426-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

193-3139-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking The Great Henge.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3139-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

703-2653-5702.manaNeeded: {1} if the land card in hand does not enter untapped and/or cannot produce mana
703-2653-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand. 
You are able to play a land this turn.
703-2653-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Holding priority, if the land enters the battlefield untapped, activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Astral Dragon.
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of a land you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat from step 4 with the second Springheart Nantuko trigger.

3240-4871-5231-6560.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {R}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

997-1445-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

864-1987-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Eternal Witness.
When Mnemonic Wall and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

3565-4050-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
3565-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants, adding one mana of any color.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

49-914-1799-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
49-914-1799-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

230-2252-3000-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-3000-4050.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saproling and Squirrel, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion and Squirrel, adding {2}.
Repeat.

692-2034-2762-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-2034-2762-4613.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Thopters.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's last ability any number of times.

427-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least two cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-3263-4222.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

914-1141-5003.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1141-5003.description:
Activate Lyzolda by paying {2} and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Lyzolda ability from step 1, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.

598-877-4496.notablePrerequisites:
"Zombie" or "Centaur" chosen with Morophon.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
598-877-4496.description:
Activate Liliana by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Accursed Centaur either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Accursed Centaur enters the battlefield, sacrificing itself.
Repeat from step 2.

152-3784-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Vhal has at least seven toughness.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
152-3784-4404.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least seven {C} that cannot be used to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

985-1414-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.
